metrics.profile_summary: Versatile professional with 15 years of experience across sales, marketing, administration, and teaching. Strong background in brand promotion and customer support with a focus on operational efficiency and team collaboration.

experience.description: Assisted in marketing campaigns, customer engagement, and product promotion to achieve targets.
Managed data entry, documentation, and basic accounting tasks using QuickBooks.
Handled Shopify and social media management, resolved customer queries, and maintained interaction records.
Managed office administration and taught students from KG to 5th standard.
Executed company strategies, managed sales reporting and forecasting, and achieved top promoter status in the South region.

strengths: Strong track record in brand promotion and sales
Diverse experience in customer support and administration
Proven ability to meet sales targets
weaknesses: Lack of GA4 and ad platform reporting expertise
No experience in strategic budget management or ROI/CAC/LTV tracking
evaluation.summary: The candidate has significant experience in sales and brand promotion but lacks the strategic marketing management, technical analytics skills (GA4), and budget ownership required for a Marketing Manager role.
